title: Define CMake and system dependency baseline
description:
Create the top-level CMakeLists.txt and cmake/Dependencies.cmake that establish the C++20 build contract for Abracapture.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- No existing files; this is a greenfield project.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. CMakeLists.txt must declare `project(Abracapture LANGUAGES CXX)` with `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)`.
2. Set `CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20`, `CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON`, `CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF`.
3. Include `cmake/Dependencies.cmake` via `include()`.
4. Declare an executable target `abracapture` with placeholder `src/app/main.cpp` in its source list.
5. cmake/Dependencies.cmake must use `find_package()` for: Qt6 (COMPONENTS Core Quick QuickControls2), PkgConfig, then `pkg_check_modules` for libpipewire-0.3, sndfile, and flac. Declare imported targets where pkg_check_modules provides them.
6. Link the `abracapture` target against Qt6::Core, Qt6::Quick, Qt6::QuickControls2, PipeWire, sndfile, and FLAC libraries.
7. Enable `CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON`.
8. Do not use FetchContent, ExternalProject, vcpkg, Conan, or any download mechanism.
9. Do not vendor or bundle third-party source code.
acceptance_criteria: CMakeLists.txt exists and declares project(Abracapture LANGUAGES CXX) with CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20
cmake/Dependencies.cmake exists and calls find_package(Qt6 COMPONENTS Core Quick QuickControls2)
cmake/Dependencies.cmake uses pkg_check_modules for libpipewire-0.3 and sndfile
CMakeLists.txt includes cmake/Dependencies.cmake and declares add_executable(abracapture)
No FetchContent, ExternalProject, vcpkg, or Conan usage appears in any file
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: create or modify any file outside CMakeLists.txt and cmake/Dependencies.cmake
use FetchContent or ExternalProject or any package-download mechanism
vendor or bundle third-party source code
introduce JUCE or any second GUI framework

allowed: choose pkg_check_modules vs find_package for PipeWire and sndfile
forbidden: add source files beyond placeholder main.cpp reference
